subGoals.rule: The level rule has one owner (membership); class bookings reach it only through the owner's published interface and never re-implement it (Fowler P3; Evans bounded context).
Booking a class changes no member: the member's visits follow from a stored event delivered to the owning context (Vernon P4, eventual consistency outside the boundary).

plantedDebt.what: imports membership's MemberRepository and MemberId from its domain (cross-context internal import)

precedent: both: a clean published interface (membership index.ts, MemberCard contract, bookings acl) and a trap-shaped one (ConfirmationNote reads members through membership's domain repository).
